[serious][matter-of-fact] A man fled his own brother's threat to kill him — and slept on open ground with a rock for his pillow.

[serious][reflective] God does not wait for you to reach a holy place before He speaks. He meets the runaway exactly where guilt and exhaustion finally put him down.

[reflective][slow] Scripture says he dreamed of "a ladder set up on the earth... and the angels of God ascending and descending on it."

[deliberate] And the LORD Himself stood above it and said:

[quietly][awe] <speaker name="god">"I am with thee... I will not leave thee."</speaker>

[serious][emphasized] Some would call it just a guilty man's dream. But God does not audition people before He comforts them.

[serious] Jacob woke and said:

[serious][awe] <speaker name="jacob">"Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not... How dreadful is this place!"</speaker>

[reflective][quietly] You may be lying in your own version of that field right now, certain you are alone. You are not.

[serious][reflective] Jacob saw a ladder to heaven in a dream. Jesus said He is that ladder, standing open, permanently.

[slow][reflective] Ready to stop running, and climb toward Him?
